tools.name: get_person_profile
tools.description:
Returns a full profile including experience, education, and skills.

Obtain a `memberId` from `/people/search` or `/company/{companyId}/employees`.
Note that profiles which are private or outside your network cannot be retrieved;
these appear in listings with the name `LinkedIn Member`. Group: Perso

tools.name: get_person_profile_posts
tools.description: Returns an empty list if the person has not posted. Group: Person. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

tools.name: get_people_search
tools.description:
All filters are optional and can be combined. Returns the same person structure as
`/company/{companyId}/employees`. Returns an empty list when nothing matches. Group: Person. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description:
Provide either `slug` or `companyId`. If neither is given, the request fails with
`400 VALIDATION_ERROR`.

Take the `slug` from a `/company/search` result rather than guessing it from the
company name — a company's slug often differs from its display name. Group: Companies. Billing per call: 1 Credi

tools.name: get_company_search
tools.description:
Use the `slug` or `companyId` from a result to fetch full details from `/company`,
the employee list, or the job list. Group: Companies. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

tools.name: get_company_companyId_employees
tools.description:
Returns people who list this company as their employer.

Results may include private or out-of-network profiles, which appear with the name
`LinkedIn Member`. Full profiles cannot be retrieved for those records, so check
the name before calling `/person-profile` with the returned `memberId`. Group:

tools.name: get_company_companyId_jobs
tools.description:
Returns an empty list if the company has no open postings.
Use the `jobId` from a result with `/jobs/detail/{jobId}`. Group: Companies. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

tools.name: get_company_posts
tools.description:
Returns the same post structure as `/person-profile/posts`.
This endpoint is addressed by `slug` only. Group: Companies. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

tools.name: get_jobs_search
tools.description: Use the `jobId` from a result with `/jobs/detail/{jobId}`. Group: Jobs. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

tools.name: get_jobs_detail_jobId
tools.description:
Returns the full description for a posting. Several fields are only present on some
postings; the company name is most reliably taken from the search result that
provided the `jobId`. Group: Jobs. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

tools.name: get_posts_postId_comments
tools.description: Returns an empty list when the post has no comments. Group: Posts. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

tools.name: get_posts_postId_reactions
tools.description: Returns an empty list when the post has no reactions. Group: Posts. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_company_companyId_employees" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Returns people who list this company as their employer. Results may include private or out-of-network profiles, which appear with the name `LinkedIn Member`. Fu…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "linkedin" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_person_profile_posts, get_company_posts, get_posts_postId_comments, get_posts_postId_reactions · Private data: get_person_profile, get_company_companyId_employees · Public sink: get_company_posts, get_posts_postId_comments, get_posts_postId_reactions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_person_profile_posts, get_company_posts, get_posts_postId_comments, get_posts_postId_reactions · Private data: get_person_profile, get_company_companyId_employees · Public sink: get_company_posts, get_posts_postId_comments, get_posts_postId_reactions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
